ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.9.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - WorldNews
Companion Mod for RimSynapse. Makes the RimWorld feel alive, reactive, and historically grounded by acting as the local journalist and gossip mill for the planet. Generates dynamic newspapers based on real events in your game.
--- Roadmap --- 0.10 - Cross-Mod Capability Passes: event-driven publication cadence, on-demand news tools for the LLM, comms-console delivery, and another pass over how the news draws on every module. Future - Ideological artefacts abroad: the article, the conversion, and the war it might start (awaiting a regional belief model). These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog (v0.9.0) - The Newspaper Reports the World --- - NEW - World-map news: the newspaper now reports changes across the planet, not just your colony - regions changing hands, new settlements founded, and rising tension between hostile neighbours who share a frontier (with Regions and Territories). - NEW - Quest outcomes become news: when a quest resolves, the factions whose territory it happened in react to how it turned out - the neighbours have opinions, not just the quest giver. - NEW - Settlement affairs: non-player settlements have eventful days - raids, caravans, festivals, outbreaks - and conflict outcomes nudge the two factions' short-term standing by a small, temporary amount that fades over a few days. - Every world-map detector is individually toggleable in settings, and all world-map coverage stands down cleanly when Regions and Territories is absent.
--- Changelog (v0.8.0) - The Colony Newspaper --- - NEW - The colony newspaper: WorldNews now renders a full newspaper issue from a single model, in-game and as a shareable HTML export. - NEW - Optional AI-generated images for newspaper stories (opt-in), plus a configurable banner. - The newspaper wires into Core's deferred-letter pipeline; publishing holds for images, empty papers are guarded, and ad art renders in black and white.
--- Changelog (v0.7.0) - Regions and Territories Compatibility --- - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.7.0. - Requires Core v0.7.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged.
Full version history: https://github.com/RimSynapse/WorldNews/wiki/Changelog
--- Compatibility Matrix --- - RimSynapse - Regions and Territories: Recommended and Optional. WorldNews reads its territory, borders and regional beliefs to report the world map - border shifts, new outposts and ideology changes become news. Without it, WorldNews still loads and reports colony-local events as usual; only the world-map coverage stands down. - Royalty DLC: Compatible and Optional. Generates newspapers tracking royal ascensions and empire news. - Ideology DLC: Compatible and Optional. Generates theological debate columns and festival coverage. - Biotech DLC: Compatible and Optional. Generates genetic breakthrough and mechanitor threat articles. - Anomaly DLC: Compatible and Optional. Generates creepy tabloid stories about void sightings. - RimSynapse - Factions: Compatible and Optional. WorldNews will dynamically report on the procedurally generated histories, schisms, and wars of your custom LLM factions. - RimSynapse - Psychology: Compatible and Optional. Newspapers will gossip about your colonists' psychological breakdowns and dramatic therapy sessions.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse - Core (Must be loaded before this mod)
